# Live status > Always-mounted polite status region that announces changes to assistive technology. This file matches the installed `live-status` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/live-status.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/live-status.md`. ## Registry dependencies - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/ui/live-status`: `LiveStatus`, types `LiveStatusProps` ## Composition ### Polite announcement Keep it mounted and change only its message. ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useState } from "react"; import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button"; import { LiveStatus } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/live-status"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; export function PrimitiveLiveStatusExample() { const [count, setCount] = useState(0); const message = count === 0 ? "" : `${count} ${count === 1 ? "file" : "files"} uploaded`; return (
{message || "Nothing uploaded yet"}
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `live-status` - `root` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/live-status - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/live-status.json
